svg.title: Known-best packing of 109 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=109 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: The source gives numerical poses. The exact verification concerns the separately derived rational packing and establishes only a finite upper bound.
